Specification: This specification models a one-variable system used to evaluate a rank-1 operator-valued constant through TLC configuration substitution. The module declares a constant operator x0 and a state variable x; the initial state sets x to TRUE, and the next-state action updates x to the Boolean result of comparing x0({"A"} \union {"B"}) with the set {"C"}. The file also includes an embedded TLC configuration that sets INIT and NEXT and overrides x0 with TLCEval, so the specification is primarily a minimal evaluator-oriented test rather than a protocol with fault tolerance or rich temporal properties.
